bbox_regression.program:
(rule!
 (let* ((h (rows g))
        (classified (cellmap g (r c v)
          (if (= v 8) (if (= (at g (- (- h 1) r) c) 8) 2 5) 0)))
        (parts (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 2)) (objects classified 0)))
        (winner (foldl (lambda (o best)
                  (if (or (not best) (> (obj-size o) (obj-size best))) o best)) #f parts))
        (selected-rows (if winner (remove-duplicates (map first (obj-cells winner))) '())))
   (cellmap classified (r c v)
     (if (and (= v 5) (member r selected-rows)) 4 v))))
bbox_regression.rival_program:
(rule!
 (let* ((h (rows g))
        (classified (cellmap g (r c v)
          (if (= v 8) (if (= (at g (- (- h 1) r) c) 8) 2 5) 0)))
        (parts (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 2)) (objects classified 0)))
        (winner (foldl (lambda (o best)
                  (if (or (not best) (> (* (obj-h o) (obj-w o)) (* (obj-h best) (obj-w best)))) o best)) #f parts))
        (selected-rows (if winner (remove-duplicates (map first (obj-cells winner))) '())))
   (cellmap classified (r c v)
     (if (and (= v 5) (member r selected-rows)) 4 v))))

limitations: Finite rival class and bounded seeds only. Most census labels are Python claims. No owner acceptance or training admission.
